hero.title: Financial Commission Dispute Resolution and [Compensation Fund]
hero.text: Both GTC Global Ltd and GTC Global Trade Capital Ltd jointed Financial Commission as official members — Financial Commission, an international organization dedicated to resolving financial service disputes in the foreign exchange industry and providing traders with additional financial protection.

about.whatText: As a neutral third-party commission, the Financial Commission impartially reviews and resolves transaction disputes, offering a simpler and faster solution compared to industry regulators and judicial proceedings. Independent of any party, the commission ensures that dispute resolution is swift, efficient, fair, and credible.
about.bringTitle: What does it bring to traders?
bring: Fast, fair, and transparent dispute resolution
Additional funding is provided by the Compensation Fund.
A fully independent third-party external dispute resolution (EDR) institution.

managed.title: How are the [funds managed?]
managed.description: The Compensation Fund is a compensation mechanism maintained by the Financial Commission for eligible clients of its members. According to the Financial Commission's Rules, the Fund is held in a separate bank account and may be used to satisfy an eligible Award if a member fails or refuses to comply with that Award, or ceases to be a member before paying it. Any payment is subject to the applicable Rules, compensation limits and available fund balance. The Fund is not an insurance policy, deposit-guarantee scheme or general protection against trading losses or broker insolvency. It applies only to eligible claims made against the specific legal entity that holds Financial Commission membership.

items.q: What is MetaTrader 4?
items.a: MetaTrader 4 (MT4) is a widely used trading platform for forex and CFD markets, recognized for its stability, user-friendly interface, advanced charting tools, and support for automated trading through Expert Advisors (EAs). The MT 4 trading platform allows traders to analyze markets, execute trades, and manage positions across multiple instruments.

items.q: Does MT4 support automated trading (Expert Advisors)?
items.a: Yes. The MT4 trading platform supports Expert Advisors (EAs) written in MQL4, allowing traders to automate strategies, run custom indicators, and backtest systems using historical data before deploying them in live markets.

items.q: Which devices is MT4 available on?
items.a: MT4 is available as a desktop application (Windows), a web-based platform accessible from any browser, and mobile apps for iOS and Android — allowing you to manage trades and monitor the market across devices with synced account access.

items.q: Is MT4 suitable for beginners?

items.q: What is MetaTrader 5?
items.a: MetaTrader 5 (MT5) is a multi-asset trading platform and the more advanced successor to MT4. The MT5 platform offers expanded order types, additional timeframes, an integrated economic calendar, and access to a broader range of markets, including forex, stocks, commodities, and indices, depending on your broker's offering.

items.q: What's the difference between MT4 and MT5?
items.a: MT5 offers more built-in technical indicators and timeframes, a more advanced strategy tester with multi-threaded backtesting, an integrated economic calendar, and support for hedging and netting account modes. MT4 remains popular for its simplicity, lighter resource use, and extensive Expert Advisor ecosystem, while MT5 provides a broader toolkit and multi-asset support. For a detailed comparison, see our {mt4Mt5GuideLink}.
items.guideLinkText: MT4 vs MT5 trading platform guide

items.q: Can I run Expert Advisors on MT5?
items.a: Yes. MT5 supports Expert Advisors written in MQL5, which is not directly compatible with MQL4 code — EAs and custom indicators built for MT4 generally need to be rewritten or converted to work on MT5.

items.q: Does MT5 support hedging?
items.a: Yes. MT5 supports both netting and hedging account types. With hedging mode enabled, you can hold simultaneous long and short positions on the same instrument — useful for advanced strategies like grid trading, lock-and-hedge, and multi-timeframe position management. Contact support@gtcfx.com to confirm which mode is available on your account type.

items.q: Which devices is MT5 available on?
items.a: MT5 is available as a desktop application for Windows, a web-based trading platform accessible from any browser without downloads, and mobile apps for iOS and Android. Download MetaTrader 5 to access your account, manage positions, and monitor the markets across devices with a consistent trading experience.

items.q: Should I choose MT5 over MT4?
items.a: It depends on your trading style. If you rely on a specific MT4-only EA or prefer MT4's lighter, simpler interface, MT4 may suit you better. If you want a broader range of tradable instruments, faster backtesting, or more advanced order types, MT5 is generally the stronger choice. Many traders use both simultaneously depending on the strategy.
